title: A1 Swaara v1.0.5 - Universal Background Blur & Adaptive Center Layout
changelog:
- Universal multi-tier background blur ensuring gorgeous, diffuse artwork hazing across all Android versions (API 23 to API 36+)
- Dynamic mesh glow canvas and CPU StackBlur fallback for phones without RenderEffect
- Adaptive player UI centering: horizontally and vertically centered layout across all screen ratios, foldables, and compact displays
- Fixed control over-spreading on wide screens and prevented bottom row cutoff on phones with navigation bars
